title: Average influence and noise sensitivity
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number and let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{-1,1\}$. Its average influence, multiplied by $(1-e^{-2})/2$, is at most its noise sensitivity at flip probability $1/n$, where the input is uniform and each coordinate is independently flipped with that probability.
